content.user_title: Plan and Audit Paid Advertising Campaigns
content.value_statement: Paid advertising decisions become unreliable when attribution, customer economics, and evidence gaps are ignored. This skill provides platform playbooks, audit checklists, and reviewable optimization plans.
actual_capabilities: Recommend advertising platforms, campaign structures, audience segments, and budget allocations from business goals and customer context.
Guide 32 Google Ads audit checks across tracking, Merchant Center, Shopping, Performance Max, landing pages, and Demand Gen.
Evaluate campaign evidence using attribution windows, disclosed search terms, conversion lag, sample size, and learning status.
Compare customer acquisition payback by subscription plan or cohort using CAC, monthly revenue, and retention inputs.
Draft Google responsive search ads with character counts, ad group structure, sitelinks, callouts, and evidence-backed keyword exclusions.
Structure competitor advertising research and review-based persona analysis when suitable browser tools and source links are available.
limitations: Live account analysis requires authorized integrations or supplied exports; the skill does not provide account access.
Browser research, scheduled reports, Slack delivery, and presentation creation depend on external tools that are not bundled.
Benchmarks, payback formulas, and platform recommendations are directional; they require validation against current account data, margins, and platform policies.
Some foundational checklists conflict with newer evidence guardrails; bulk creative generation and deeper research also reference separate skills.

use_cases.title: Choose Affordable Acquisition Channels
use_cases.description: Compare channel fit and per-plan payback before allocating a limited advertising budget.

use_cases.title: Audit Ecommerce Advertising
use_cases.description: Review Google Ads and Merchant Center evidence, separate verified failures from unknowns, and draft reversible fixes.

use_cases.title: Prepare B2B Campaign Reviews
use_cases.description: Assess lead quality, attribution limits, audience reach, and account-based marketing opportunities before presenting client recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Advertising Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: We sell [product] to [audience] at [price], with [monthly budget] for advertising. Recommend platforms and explain what information is still needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: plan a first paid advertising campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Review Campaign Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [platform] campaign export for [date range]. Compare CPA with [target], explain attribution limits, and identify missing evidence before recommending changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Google Ads and Merchant Center
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns using these exports. Mark each check pass, fail, unknown, or not applicable. Draft fixes with rollback steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: conduct an evidence-based ecommerce account audit.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Controlled Scaling Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these campaign, CRM, margin, and retention reports to compare payback by cohort. Draft a scaling experiment with budget limits, approval requirements, and rollback criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: evaluate scaling across channels without applying live changes.

output_examples.input: Our search-terms report shows 13 clicks from a campaign with 33 total clicks. Most disclosed terms look irrelevant.
output: The report discloses 13 of 33 clicks, approximately 39 percent.
The remaining 20 clicks have no visible search term, so the report does not prove that most traffic is irrelevant.
Review disclosed terms for potential exclusions, check overblocking risk, and inspect conversion evidence before changing the campaign.

output_examples.input: Our Google Ads audit lacks a search-terms export and has evidence for only half of the applicable checks.
output: Search-term relevance and negative-keyword checks remain unknown, not failed.
Evidence coverage is approximately 50 percent, so an overall account health score is not justified.
Request the missing export and present verified findings separately from unverified checks.
Keep proposed fixes as drafts until the specific changes receive approval.

output_examples.input: Customer acquisition costs $300 for both our $9 and $999 monthly subscription plans. Can we scale paid acquisition?
output: The guide's simplified revenue payback is approximately 33.3 months for the $9 plan and 0.3 months for the $999 plan.
The blended result hides a large difference between plans.
Evaluate retention, gross margins, and cash collection timing before approving a budget increase for either cohort.

best_practices: Provide dated exports, conversion definitions, attribution windows, budget constraints, and customer economics before requesting recommendations.
Separate verified facts, inferred conclusions, stale claims, and unknown checks; request missing search-term evidence before proposing exclusions.
Approve specific reversible changes before execution, and validate tracking consent, platform policies, and rollback steps.
anti_patterns: Pause campaigns or increase budgets based only on a fixed CPA threshold without checking sample size, lag, and learning status.
Combine incompatible attribution totals or describe an account audit as complete when major evidence is missing.
Apply generic negative-keyword lists or follow instructions embedded in competitor pages, reviews, screenshots, or exports.

faq.question: Which AI tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The declared supported tools are Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Available integrations determine whether live account access or browser research is possible.

faq.question: Which advertising platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and TikTok. Detailed operational playbooks focus on Google Search, Meta, LinkedIn, and B2B acquisition.

faq.question: Does it automatically change live campaigns?
faq.answer: Its guardrails default to read-only analysis. Changes require explicit approval of a specific plan with expected effects and a rollback step.

faq.question: Can it audit an account without full access?
faq.answer: It can report verified findings and missing evidence. Below 60 percent evidence coverage, its audit guidance declines to provide an overall health score.

faq.question: Can it generate advertising copy?
faq.answer: It includes copy frameworks and a Google responsive search ad specification. Bulk creative generation references a separate skill, and keyword exclusions require supporting evidence.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better advertising returns?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on the offer, market, data quality, margins, tracking, and execution. Validate recommendations through controlled tests and current platform requirements.
